ValidationRule.description: Incoterms part 1 is not required for Montreal order type DR, CR and it is not required from any order type from Salem/MIA
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
(ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress') && NOT(ISBLANK(Incoterm__c)) && ISPICKVAL( Site__c , "Montreal") && ( ISPICKVAL( Order_Type__c , "Credit Memo Request") || ISPICKVAL( Order_Type__c , "Debit Memo/Bill only Request")) ) || ( ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress') && NOT(ISBLANK(Incoterm__c)) && ( ISPICKVAL( Site__c , "Salem") || ISPICKVAL( Site__c , "Miamisburg") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Incoterms part 1 is not required for selected Site and Order Type.
